name: Tucana
introduction: is the Toucan, introduced by Dutch navigators in the 1590s. It lies near the south celestial pole and contains two of the southern sky’s most remarkable sights.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: The Small Magellanic Cloud, a satellite galaxy of the Milky Way about 200,000 light-years away, lies in Tucana. Next to it, 47 Tucanae is one of the brightest globular clusters in the sky, a dense ball of millions of stars.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Lang-Exster](hip:110130), Alpha Tucanae, is an orange giant. [Zeta Tucanae](hip:1599), 28 light-years away, is a Sun-like star, and [Beta¹ Tucanae](hip:2484) is part of a multiple system.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Tucana contains other globular clusters and galaxies, including the Tucana Dwarf.
